page_title: LEN 2-3 MON | Lens v Monaco 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens) duly receives a yellow card.
90+2' The referee gives a yellow card to Wout Faes (Monaco).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Substitution. Andrija Bulatovic did his best and is replaced by Florian Sotoca (Lens).
87' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Anthony Bermont (Lens) replacing Ruben Aguilar.
86' Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul after Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) hacks down one of his opponents.
86' Wonderful movement by Lens. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
85' It will be a substitution. Mika Biereth (Monaco) is ready to enter the pitch as Folarin Balogun walks off.
83' Lens play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
80' Lens win a corner.
77' Lens fail to score from a corner as Philipp Kohn (Monaco) leaps to collect the ball.
75' Substitution. Allan Saint-Maximin makes his way off the pitch and Rayan Fofana (Lens) comes on as his replacement.
75' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Ruben Aguilar (Lens) replaces Saud Abdulhamid.
74' Yellow card! It's like Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Willy Delajod agrees and books him.
72' Goal! Ansu Fati (Monaco) goes on a mazy run and from the edge of the box beats Robin Risser with a delightful chipped finish. 2:3.

70' 2 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Denis Zakaria (Monaco) meets a brilliant cross from Caio Henrique and scores with a bullet header from close range in off the crossbar. Robin Risser had no chance of stopping that. The score is 2:2.
69' The game has come to an end for Simon Adingra. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ansu Fati (Monaco).
67' Abdallah Sima picks out Florian Thauvin (Lens) unmarked inside the box, but his strike goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Odsonne Edouard walks off the pitch to be replaced by Abdallah Sima (Lens).
62' 2 - 1 Folarin Balogun (Monaco) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
61' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
56' 2 - 0 Goal! Florian Thauvin (Lens) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
55' Florian Thauvin (Lens) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Philipp Kohn easily deals with the threat.
52' Monaco keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition.
48' Lens will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45+1' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
42' Simon Adingra (Monaco) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
39' Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes the corner with a short pass.
38' Caio Henrique (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
37' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' Jordan Teze (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
35' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
34' Andrija Bulatovic (Lens) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
33' The Lens players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
31' Sebastien Pocognoli is forced to make a change. Krepin Diatta is unable to continue due to injury, Aladji Bamba (Monaco) comes on.
27' The game is interrupted now, Krepin Diatta (Monaco) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
21' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
20' Florian Thauvin (Lens) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Odsonne Edouard, but Philipp Kohn displays great awareness to stop him.
18' 5:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
16' Referee Willy Delajod signals NO PENALTY for Lens after a VAR review!
15' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lens players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Willy Delajod interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
14' Surely that's handball by one of the Monaco players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
13' Florian Thauvin (Lens) launches a cross from the corner, but Philipp Kohn is alert to thwart the effort.
11' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
11' The ball is behind the sideline. Caio Henrique (Monaco) takes a throw-in.
9' Wout Faes (Monaco) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Willy Delajod blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
6' Malang Sarr (Lens) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks more accuracy and goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
5' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

3' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Odsonne Edouard (Lens) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
2' Monaco control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monaco will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will officiate today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
